findings.issue: Zero unit/component tests despite a fully wired Vitest runner ('ng test', @angular/build:unit-test, tsconfig.spec.json); all quality guarding is delegated to the acceptance suite the team doesn't own.
findings.suggestion: Add specs for the pure helpers, the PokedexData transformations, and the resolvers (with a mocked Api) — the module boundaries (Api injectable, pure util functions, resolver return shapes) make this cheap.

findings.issue: cardsFor is the riskiest function in the app — alternate-form exclusion by id > 10000, Pokémon→species mapping with a fallback HTTP fetch, dedup by species id, and note lookup keyed by Pokémon name — all untested. A latent bug already exists: if two Pokémon of the same species appear (e.g. one holding the hidden-ability note), only the first note wins because byId.has() short-circuits.
findings.suggestion: Unit-test with a stub Api: alt forms excluded, deoxys-normal mapped to deoxys, dedup, ordering by dex id, and note propagation for duplicate species.

findings.issue: sortedRows implements subtle sorting semantics (missing values last in both directions, tie-breaks, dir multiplication, number-vs-string comparison) with no tests; acceptance tests exercise one column on one Pokémon.
findings.suggestion: Add specs over a small MoveRow fixture asserting null-last ascending and descending, tie-break order, and that ariaSort/toggleSort flip correctly.

findings.issue: buildMoveTables dedup key ('move|method|level'), method ranking (level-up/machine/egg/tutor then alphabetical) and default game selection (highest order, honoring ?game=) are pure-ish logic that a data-layer refactor could easily break silently.
findings.suggestion: Extract and spec with canned version_group_details: duplicate entries collapsed, method order, unknown methods sorted last alphabetically, invalid ?game= falls back to latest.

findings.issue: Filter + pagination computeds (case-insensitive humanized-name substring match, type/generation membership, 48-per-page slice, page clamping) and the query-param round-trip are untested; subtle bugs like off-by-one in the slice or dropping the page clamp would slip through.
findings.suggestion: Spec the computeds directly (they're signal-based and easy to drive) for filtering edge cases, page=0/999/garbage clamping, and 'No Pokémon found' when empty.

findings.issue: URL building relies on a fragile ternary (paths with '?' skip the trailing slash) and the promise cache only evicts on rejection; changing either would produce wrong URLs or cached stale data with no failing test.
findings.suggestion: Unit-test get() with a stubbed HttpClient: path normalization ('type/fire' → 'type/fire/', 'type/?limit=100' unchanged), cache hit without a second request, rejection eviction and retry.

findings.issue: Bare catch{} in every resolver (also move.resolver.ts:48-51, ability.resolver.ts:40-43, type.resolver.ts:42-45) converts any programming error into a 404 'Not found' page, hiding real bugs behind a benign-looking result.
findings.suggestion: Catch only HTTP 404s (rethrow everything else) and add a resolver test asserting a missing name yields null while a broken path still throws.

findings.issue: Pure helpers — idFromUrl regex (NaN on non-numeric URLs), latestEnglishFlavor (last English entry, whitespace collapse), orDash, dexNumber padding — are the cheapest tests in the codebase and have none; the species-id regex feeds card exclusion logic.
findings.suggestion: A 20-line spec file covering humanize, idFromUrl, dexNumber, latestEnglishFlavor and orDash edge cases.

findings.issue: The imperative effect syncing searchText with the URL (lastRequestedSearch dance for back/forward navigation) is exactly the kind of stateful code that regresses invisibly; no test covers typing → URL update → back button → box re-synced.
findings.suggestion: A component test with a real Router asserting the search box value after browser-back navigation.

findings.issue: SSR-specific behaviour — RESPONSE_INIT 404 status from resolvers, server route render modes, and the Express handler — has no verification; the 404-status code path is only reachable by manual inspection.
findings.suggestion: At minimum a request-level test against the built server asserting /pokemon/missingno returns 404 and valid pages return 200.

summary: The app ships with the Vitest runner fully configured but not a single test file, so every behaviour rests on the provided acceptance suite. The untested surface includes genuinely risky code: alternate-form/species mapping, move-table dedup and ordering, null-last sorting, URL-state filtering/pagination, and a fragile URL-building ternary. Worse, bare catch blocks in all four resolvers would disguise future bugs as 404 pages. The clean separation into pure utils, an injectable Api and resolver return shapes makes adding high-value tests cheap, which makes their absence harder to excuse.

untested.area: Pokémon→species mapping and card building (pokedex-data.ts cardsFor: alt-form exclusion, dedup, fallback fetch, note propagation)
untested.likelyBug: Alternate forms leaking into lists, duplicate cards, or the hidden-ability note being dropped when a duplicate species entry is encountered first — the byId.has() short-circuit already has this shape.

untested.area: Move-table sorting (pokemon-detail.ts sortedRows): missing-values-last in both directions, tie-breaks, ascending→descending flip, aria-sort
untested.likelyBug: Nulls jumping to the top on a second click, tie-breaks reordering rows between renders, or aria-sort claiming a sort the data doesn't reflect.

untested.area: buildMoveTables (pokemon.resolver.ts): dedup key, per-version-group filtering, method rank order, default-game selection from ?game=
untested.likelyBug: Duplicate rows after a dedup-key tweak, methods appearing out of Level Up/Machine/Egg/Tutor order, or an invalid ?game= crashing instead of falling back to the latest game.

untested.area: Home filtering, pagination and URL state (home.ts): substring match, type/generation membership, 48/page slice, page clamping, filter-change reset to page 1
untested.likelyBug: Off-by-one in the page slice (47 or 49 species per page), out-of-range ?page=999 rendering an empty list instead of the last page, or a filter change that doesn't reset the page.

untested.area: Api URL construction and caching (api.ts): trailing-slash ternary, promise cache, failure eviction
untested.likelyBug: Malformed request URLs for paths containing '?', or a failed request cached forever after a refactor of the rejection handler.

untested.area: Resolver error handling / 404 semantics (all four resolvers plus RESPONSE_INIT status on the server)
untested.likelyBug: Any thrown TypeError inside a resolver silently rendering as 'Not found', hiding data-layer regressions behind a plausible 404.

untested.area: Pure helpers (util.ts): humanize, idFromUrl, dexNumber padding, latestEnglishFlavor whitespace collapse, orDash
untested.likelyBug: idFromUrl returning NaN for a URL shape change, breaking alt-form exclusion (>NaN is false, so alternate forms would flood lists).

untested.area: Search box ↔ URL sync effect (home.ts lastRequestedSearch) for back/forward navigation
untested.likelyBug: Browser-back leaving a stale search string in the input, or typing triggering a redundant navigation loop after an effect refactor.
